title: GitLab Legacy personal access token: one-property twin (length) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 19 vs contracted 20. Twin of "GitLab Legacy personal access token: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of gitlab-token-pat-plain: length: 19 vs contracted 20. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
